Sandboxing & Resources

Safe execution environments for autonomous coding agents.

The Danger of exec()

You cannot let an agent run rm -rf / on your server. Sandboxing isolates the agent's code execution enviornment.

Tools

Docker

Spin up a transient container for each agent session. Destroy it after the task.

E2B (Code Interpreter)

A managed cloud sandbox optimized for AI agents. Allows file upload/download and long-running processes.

WebAssembly (Wasm)

Running code directly in the browser or lightweight strict runtime.

Resource Management

Deep agents need more than just CPU. They need:

  • Virtual File System: A place to write intermediate files (`data.csv`, `plot.png`).
  • Browser: A headless browser (Puppeteer/Playwright) to interact with the web.
